sql: SELECT job_id, title FROM jobs
SELECT * FROM jobs
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM jobs
SELECT j.job_id, c.company_name FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = j.company_id
SELECT j.job_id, c.company_name FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = j.company_id
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE city = '北京' AND job_type = '实习'
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE city = '北京' OR city = '上海'
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE city IN ('北京', '上海')
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE city NOT IN ('北京', '上海')
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE title LIKE '%开发%'
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE title NOT LIKE '%销售%'
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE city IS NULL
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE city IS NOT NULL
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE job_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01'
SELECT job_id, COALESCE(city, '未知') AS city_name FROM jobs
SELECT COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM jobs
SELECT s.skill_name, COUNT(js.job_id) AS job_count FROM skills s JOIN job_skills js ON js.skill_id = s.skill_id GROUP BY s.skill_id, s.skill_name
SELECT city, COUNT(job_id) AS job_count FROM jobs GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(job_id) > 1
SELECT job_type, COUNT(job_id) AS job_count FROM jobs GROUP BY job_type LIMIT 20
SELECT city, COUNT(job_id) AS job_count FROM jobs GROUP BY city LIMIT 500
SELECT job_id, title FROM jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 20
SELECT YEAR(created_at) AS year_value, COUNT(job_id) AS job_count FROM jobs GROUP BY YEAR(created_at)
SELECT MONTH(created_at) AS month_value, COUNT(job_id) AS job_count FROM jobs GROUP BY MONTH(created_at)
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS created_date FROM jobs
SELECT UPPER(city) AS city_upper FROM jobs
SELECT LOWER(title) AS normalized_title FROM jobs
SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(requirement_json, '$.education_requirements')) AS education FROM jobs
